name: EmbSpatial-Bench
intro: EmbSpatial-Bench从Matterport3D、ScanNet和AI2-THOR的带标注三维场景构建具身空间多选题。流程将三维物体投影到RGB-D图像，提取观察者视角的上、下、左、右、近、远关系，并通过精确边界框过滤和逐题人工核验形成3,640题评测集。EmbSpatial-SFT是独立训练集，不进入该评测集。
build_method: MP3D/ScanNet随机视点与AI2-THOR任务关键帧, 三维投影, 六类空间关系提取, 模板组题, 精确框过滤, 逐题人工核验
eval_feature: 观察者视角六类空间关系, 真实与仿真室内场景, 零样本生成式与最大似然选项评测
scale: 3,640个问答对, 2,181张图像, 277个场景, 294个物体类别
build_method_en: MP3D/ScanNet random viewpoints and AI2-THOR task key frames, 3D projection, six-relation extraction, template QA, exact box filtering, per-item human verification
eval_feature_en: Viewer-centric six-relation coverage, real and simulated indoor scenes, zero-shot generation and maximum-likelihood option evaluation
intro_en: EmbSpatial-Bench constructs embodied spatial MCQs from annotated Matterport3D, ScanNet, and AI2-THOR scenes. It projects 3D objects into RGB-D images, extracts viewer-centric above, below, left, right, close, and far relations, and applies exact box filtering plus per-item human verification to form a 3,640-question evaluation set. EmbSpatial-SFT is a separate training set and is not mixed into the benchmark.

drawio_review_note: Evidence is frozen to arXiv:2406.05756v1 (PDF SHA-256 0c79ca1dedb219adbc60ddd80f28c747b7a09df5359c3887689c7093e2478cc7), official repo commit 75792fc5957b0142fab8ff1d47574ffcf73e02c9, and Hugging Face Phineas476/EmbSpatial-Bench revision e2733cacf0f20371518c687176e881d79644e61e (embspatial_bench.json LFS SHA-256 f9427218bb69afa218ca075e7efc1ca7a0a2379f87c0b55e4813ca19b9de0fa8, 253,512,493 bytes). Paper Sections 2.1–2.2 and Appendices A.1/A.4/B.2 support MP3D test and ScanNet validation scenes, seven ALFRED task types across 93 AI2-THOR scenes, random MP3D/ScanNet viewpoints, PDDL subgoal key frames, camera/3D projection, non-overlapping boxes, whole-box directional relations, mean-depth close/far, five directional templates, closest/farthest aggregation, the exact <50 px or >half-axis box filters, relation balancing, and the three human checks: unique/clear objects, correct target relation, and incorrect negative options. Table 1 supplies every per-source count and the 3,640 QA / 2,181 image / 277 scene / 294-object-category totals. Zero-shot generation and argmax option-likelihood accuracy are shown; EmbSpatial-SFT is explicitly excluded.
